steps.speaker: Corpseborne?
steps.content: Ahhh!!! Can't die, I can't die!
The shackles rip the monster's body into pieces. It turns into ashes and vanishes. Strangely enough, nothing enters your body.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: I thought you'd be more careful after that. Aren't you afraid your body may not take it well?

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: At least it's gone now. You should feel blessed you're still alive.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: You don't need to thank me. We made a deal, an excellent deal. I'll be looking forward to it.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: I believe that day... will come soon.
You want to ask her something else when a familiar figure suddenly hops out and grabs your collar, shaking you violently.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Didn't I ******* tell you not to do anything stupid?! You...

A beating is inevitable, naturally. You skillfully prepare yourself to give her the apology and excuse you've rehearsed, but before you start, the girl stops beating and cursing you. Her voice doesn't sound right.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Sob... You killed it... The Black Ring didn't erupt, and you didn't die... Nightingale will be here soon, she said she'd be quick...
Hella buries her ashen face in your chest, her body shaking uncontrollably like a child just woken from a nightmare.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I saw many, many dead bodies on the way... Some of them were Lavina's friends, and...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I couldn't do anything, couldn't save anyone... I thought the Black Ring was gonna...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Thank goodness, you killed it... I'm so glad you did...
You hug her wordlessly. She's a kind and innocent girl after all. Witnessing so many deaths is too cruel for her.
You're glad you chose to stay. It was worth betting your life on that fight.

steps.speaker: Options
options: Once you feel better, we'll go find Hecate.

steps.content: She's still in the upper levels. She hasn't moved much. Judging from the shackles' response, she didn't encounter much danger.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Okay. Come here. I'll give you a piggyback. Look at the mess you got yourself into. With all these injuries, it will take a whole year if you walk by yourself.
You oblige and lean onto her back. Before leaving, you turn back.
Oak Casket has already left, leaving only the silent monument. In the sunlight, half of it is still buried in darkness.

steps.speaker: [Transition] (Staircase background)
steps.content: Beneath the crypt, the ominous pulsations are still continuing. The gangsters are growing uneasy. They've obviously received the signals sent by the sentries, and the grand battle is ready to break out any moment now.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: My original plan was that the two of us would get out quickly, relay the message, and immediately come back for you. But we only took a few steps before Hecate insisted on coming back.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Earlier, she couldn't wait for another second to see you. Now she is taking her sweet time to come out. I wonder what's taking her so long...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tsk, it's all your fault! I forbid you from acting alone next time! You hear me? Come here, let's get your face cleaned up. If she sees your injuries, she's gonna...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hecate!
The blue-haired Sinner sits atop the staircase, holding onto the wall and peering down at you. Nightmare has recovered but still seems a little floaty, looking as weak as she is.
Caught off guard, you didn't have time to wipe off the blood on you or get off Hella to make yourself look robust.
But she only looks stunned for a moment, then bows her head and walks down step by step arduously. She comes over to support you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, are you okay?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I heard Dudu's suona. She healed me with her power. The Corpseborne has been banished. It's all over now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What about you? Are you okay?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'm fine.
Her voice is emotionless, and she doesn't look at you. Something seems off. Is it the effect of that battle just now? Is she mad?

No, that's not it. You know this expression well. It's that stiff expression she had when you first met her, when she only knew to obey orders. But her hands are clutching your sleeve tightly, her knuckles turning white from the grip.
She finally looks up at you, but the windows in her eyes are tightly shut.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'm fine. But things are happening on the Rustfire side.
You want to say more, but a furious roar suddenly comes from above.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I think you'll need to make your judgment, Chief.

steps.speaker: (Scene change)
steps.content: Julien's Office

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Julien, hang in there! I'll tend to it right away. Who did this to you? What happened?!

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Doctor! ****! Where's the doctor? Hurry up...
He hears the footsteps and is yelling to the door, but freezes the moment he sees you.
You look past Taran and see the ashen-faced architect next to him. Julien has slumped on the floor, his legs pressed under the fallen rocks, blood welling out toward you.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...Ha, you made it back... You did it...
You dash to him, wanting to lift that huge rock but unable to gather enough strength. After Hella and the feeble Nightmare join you, you're finally able to move the rock away.
The man's legs have become a bloody pulp. Painfully, Taran tries to stop the bleeding.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Haha... Don't worry. My legs have never been useful anyway. Can't take two steps without stumbling. The wheelchair works way better.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I think it's fallen off somewhere though. I hope it's not ruined. It's quite time-consuming to make a new one... and exhausting.
As he speaks, he suddenly laughs.
That jaded, serious Rustfire leader is actually joking. How can he still laugh now?

steps.speaker: Options
options: How did you get so badly injured?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: With so many mechanisms here, you should have been able to better protect yourself. How come...

You remember. When the building collapsed, something protected you. The machine that knocked off the Corruptors and the mechanism that caught you. You only survived the fall from that height because...

steps.speaker: Options
options: Were you operating the mechanisms to protect me?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: It's nothing. People fall off buildings here all the time. I've... caught quite a few of them. I'm good at this.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's not the same! You almost died. I didn't ask for that favor.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I was going to die anyway. It's already a win I'm still alive.

steps.speaker: Options
options: Save your bad jokes. It's not funny at all.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Why are you mad? You don't like owing me a favor?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: It's okay. You don't owe me anything. It pleased me to do that. Thank you.
The blood loss makes his skin pale and his breathing labored, but the man's eyes bloom with vitality and light. He clutches your lapel and gives a bright smile you've never seen before.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I've been distressed... The elite squad is dead. The Drifter Camp is in ruins. Before they could even glimpse the future, they kept losing what they had, and they were even pushed to the battlefield when they felt the most lost.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I thought I could lay the path for them, but what they needed wasn't a path-builder, but a leader. With no one to lead them, their hearts would only be directionless.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Luckily, you came. You defeated the undefeatable, twice. No one could deny that. No one could look away from you.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Syndicate has lost Zoya, but it has gained you.

steps.speaker: (Scene change)
steps.content: [Scene Change]
You feel anxious.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I only came to handle Mania. I didn't mean to get involved in your business. I'm going to chase that Corpseborne next.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Of course. I can tell you more, about that Black Ring from eight years ago, about everything that happened there. I can tell you all that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In exchange, what do you ask of me?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: You don't have to give me anything. It's enough just to see you keep living.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: As long as you live, you can motivate everyone... You're a born leader.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: You'll lead us to the battlefield.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're not someone who holds back doubts. What does the Drifter Camp... What does Rustfire want? What do you want?

He doesn't answer anymore, falling unconscious with a smile. You only just realize a crowd has gathered outside that dilapidated door. It's the Rustfire members. The way they look at you has completely changed...

steps.speaker: (Scene change)
steps.content: [Scene Change]
In the contaminated ruins

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: It's all over, commander. The rats have already left. Something even more important than the Black Ring... That bigwig is coming up.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: About the Drifter Camp, thank you for not turning to the last resort. Personally, I don't wish to sacrifice the people here. I like them.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Yes, he's alive. He doesn't look well, and his body is in an abnormal condition. Apparently, there was an accident during his fight with the Corpus. He won, nonetheless.
steps.female_content: Yes, she's alive. She doesn't look well, and her body is in an abnormal condition. Apparently, there was an accident during her fight with the Corpus. She won, nonetheless.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: There are other findings. I'll let him... report to you himself.
steps.female_content: There are other findings. I'll let her... report to you herself.

steps.speaker: (Scene change)
steps.content: [Scene Change]
Wreckage of FAC-Propulsion Type 023
The man lies slumped in the ruined metal. His body contorted into a laughable pose. The broken communications device is making intermittent noise on the side.

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: Emergency announcement. Emergency announcement. Black Ring reaction confirmed in the Drifter Camp. All executive officers are to return to the headquarters to regroup and prepare to lock down the Drifter Camp. I repeat...

steps.speaker: Executive Committee
steps.content: I repeat, return to the headquarters and prepare to lock down...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Lock down on what... They've already moved once they saw a chance, idiots.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Could've told me earlier that someone capable was coming, I wouldn't have bothered to borrow this big thing and set up this scene. And in the end I didn't get anyone out, wasted my effort and offended both sides.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: What should I say when I go back... I should probably just run away... A... achoo!
The supposedly dead body twitches and suddenly sneezes loudly. Pulling the injured muscles makes the man grimace with pain, but he dares not make any sound.
The patrol are already cleaning up. The man can only swallow the pain and drag his still partly numb body down the wreckage, cursing as he rolls down.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: That ******* kid still can't shoot. Aim at the chest if you want to kill. How did those two bullets end up in my thighs, ouch...
He rolls down a gutter and finally gets up, wiping his face.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Goodbye, my beautiful Margaret. Take care, until next time.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: And that so-called expert Chief... I misjudged this time. We'll meet again.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Whoever you are, look after them, and don't do anything stupid.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Fire is coming... Be careful not to burn your friends.

steps.speaker: (Scene change)
steps.content: [Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: How come you're still not back?...

steps.speaker: (Scene change)
steps.content: (Scene change)
Dark Alley
The moon shifts to above the patio. It's a full moon with a glimmer of red. The light illuminates the graffiti on the wall, catching her eyes.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer?
steps.content: ...Oh? I don't remember seeing this last time.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer?
steps.content: So you do remember to come back... You little punks.
She walks into the room and sees the frail Julien on his sickbed.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer?
steps.content: You said to take this chance and relocate our base to avoid the Executive Committee's attention... You didn't say you were going to sacrifice your own life doing that.
After a brief silence, she lifts her hand to slap the man, but the hand freezes in mid-air.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer?
steps.content: Never mind, it won't hurt now anyway. I'll wait till you wake up.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer?
steps.content: Don't do that again, my friend. Don't pin your hopes on a leader... What you saw in him was not the future, only a phantom of the past.
steps.female_content: Don't do that again, my friend. Don't pin your hopes on a leader... What you saw in her was not the future, only a phantom of the past.

steps.content: She shakes her hand and produces a quill. With a mournful expression, she scribbles some funny words on the man's face, mumbling like she's grumbling.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer?
steps.content: Don't worry. People have settled down in the shelters. They're waiting for you to wake up. Rustfire's epic has yet to begin.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer?
steps.content: The day is already dead. The night is unclear. The only moon is rusty, we can only...
The ink on the man's face begins to float, turning into a black raven at last.

steps.speaker: Black Raven
steps.content: Caw! Ignite it. Light it up.
